en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes down about 0.7 percent as tech shares weaken
en.dek: The benchmark fell to around 22,220 points after early gains faded, with the tech index sliding more than 1 percent amid lingering AI sector concerns.
body: Hong Kong stocks closed lower on Tuesday, with the Hang Seng Index dropping roughly 0.7 percent after erasing early gains spurred by positive news from the technology sector.
The index finished near 22,220 points, while the Hang Seng Tech Index fell more than 1 percent. Mainland-listed shares edged higher, with the CSI 300 rising slightly.
Analysts noted that the return of Nvidia’s chief executive had lifted sentiment earlier in the session, but concerns over artificial-intelligence spending and valuations limited the recovery.
Turnover on the main board was moderate. The market had opened higher before reversing in the afternoon.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收市跌約0.7% 科網股偏弱
zh.dek: 指數收報約22220點，早段升幅回吐，恒生科技指數跌逾1%，人工智能相關憂慮持續。
body: 港股周二收市下跌，恒生指數約跌0.7%，早段受科技消息刺激的升幅其後回吐。
指數收報約22220點，恒生科技指數跌逾1%。內地股市則微升，滬深300指數略為上升。
分析指，英偉達行政總裁復職消息一度提振情緒，但人工智能開支及估值憂慮限制反彈。
主板成交額適中。大市早段高開後於下午倒跌。
